notes.title: We’re In Zombies vs. Vampires Fest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43719793/9023c9e3f632935fd5dffd10b7042e48c7ed45e2.png[/img]

Tokyo Waning Moon doesn't have any vampires—but it does have zombies. And yes, there's definitely a moon.
We're excited to join Steam's Zombies vs. Vampires Fest!
It’s an honor to stand alongside so many legendary zombie and vampire games.

During the event, Tokyo Waning Moon is 15% off.
Don’t miss this chance—and if you enjoy the game, we’d love it if you recommended it to a friend :)


🗓️ The Zombies vs. Vampires Fest runs until June 2, 2025 at 10:00 AM (PT).

—Ayumi, Developer of Tokyo Waning Moon

notes.title: Patch v１.0.1 is set live now!
notes.content:
Hello!

We just set patch v1.0.1 live!

[1.0.1] Patch Notes
- Adjusted the volume of coin collection sound effects
- Fixed a bug where best clear times were not updating properly on the result screen
- Fixed various text issues

Thank you for your continued support of Tokyo Waning Moon!

Best regards,
Ayumi

notes.title: Tokyo Waning Moon is out now!
notes.content:
[h2]Tokyo Waning Moon is out now! 🎉[/h2]

Thanks to everyone who wishlisted, or  supported us on social media - we couldn't have made it to release day without you!

Tonight in Tokyo is actually a waning moon... just like our title! 
We hope you enjoy the game!

[h3]Regarding Let's Plays and Livestreams[/h3]
Feel free to stream or create content! Monetization is OK.

Need logos or key visuals? You can grab them here:
Press Kit: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Cegv5nBDas-Rk40rZr9YTy_oCujfkWde

I'd love to see your streams and videos if you make them!


Developer's X: https://x.com/MCupcakeTokyo

Contact: https://www.midnight-cupcakes.com/contacts


Don't hesitate to reach out if you have any questions or find any issues!

Thank you,
Ayumi

notes.title: Release Date Announced!
notes.content:
Tokyo Waning Moon will launch on November 26 JST!
That is, November 25, 2024 in North America

We've also updated our Steam store page last week!
New additions include GIF animations and screenshots, along with refreshed descriptions!
A new trailer has been released as well!


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7zC2ZRlp3s0

The night of November 26 brings a true waning moon to the sky - the perfect time for our launch!

Ayumi

notes.title: The release date is delayed
notes.content:
Hello!
It has become hot in Tokyo since last week. 

Today, I need to apologize to you all. 
I had planned to release Tokyo Waning Moon in Q2 of 2023, but considering the current development status, I will be delaying the release date. 
My estimation was too optimistic for my first game development. 
I apologize to those who were looking forward the game, and would be grateful if you could wait another few months.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43719793/26e655a084016ee5f47bb8c7ae63560b9da8ac5c.gif[/img]

Thank you for your understanding.

Tokyo Waning Moon Developer
Ayumi

PS. I'm updating the progress of the development on TikTok too!
[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@ayumimidnight]https://www.tiktok.com/@ayumimidnight[/url]
